information_architecture.ux_contract: Short, simple, clear public content. No unnecessary repetition. One clear purpose per page.
information_architecture.visitor_flow: Home -> Systems -> System -> Contact, with Services & Pricing explaining the build process, pricing, and the two post-build management choices.
information_architecture.presentation_contract: One main job per page: Home explains Realty Systems Foundry; Systems shows existing systems; each System page explains that system; Services & Pricing explains the business process, pricing, and management choices; About explains the company first and Key Castro as founder; Contact collects one inquiry.

system_search.implementation: client-side progressive enhancement over server-rendered system cards

existing_system_purchase.meaning: Purchase of the published existing system as shown; customization and maintenance are not included.

commercial_model.full_handover: We build it. You manage it. Client or someone they hire handles hosting/deployment, security/updates, backups, and technical fixes after handover; no monthly management fee is charged by Realty Systems Foundry.
commercial_model.plan_selection: monthly/yearly plan keys are resolved server-side; official managed-maintenance price text is generated from trusted pricing metadata; no checkout is implied
commercial_model.legacy_compatibility: legacy subscribe/free-access URLs and old customization links are accepted only for compatibility; new public existing-system CTAs use the Existing System Purchase intent
commercial_model.maintenance_boundary: Managed care is optional. $39/month or $390/year keeps the current system running and does not include new features, workflow changes, new modules, integrations, or other improvements.

minor.meaning: Focused improvement to an existing Realty Systems Foundry system.

major.meaning: Larger improvement to an existing Realty Systems Foundry system.

new_system_or_large_expansion.meaning: Work beyond a normal system upgrade.

commercial_model.managed_by_realty_systems_foundry: We build it. We manage it. Optional managed care remains $39/month or $390/year; Realty Systems Foundry handles hosting/deployment, routine technical checks, backups when used, and technical fixes for the current system.
